newsitem.title: GERMANY: Telekom's T-Mobil buys 16 pct of U.S. APC.
newsitem.headline: Telekom's T-Mobil buys 16 pct of U.S. APC.

text.p: T-Mobil, the mobile phone unit of Deutsche Telekom AG, said on Thursday it had bought 16 percent in U.S. holding company American Personal Communications LLC (APC).
APC owns 51 percent stake in U.S. mobile network operator APC L.P.

The deal makes T-Mobil the first foreign company with a big stake in a U.S. mobile phone system and adds to its portfolio of holdings in Europe and Asia, chief executive Lothar Hunsel said in a statement.
APC started up a year ago around Washington and Baltimore with a licence covering a region of nine million people. It has 100,000 subscribers on the PCS 1900 mobile phone standard.
T-Mobil has around two million customers on its D1 network in Germany, which operates on the GSM standard. It said GSM and PCS are similar systems, but operate on different radio frequencies.
